grades: Academies and Online Seminars: current 9th to 11th grade. Pre-College: current 10th to 11th grade.
name: Penn Arts and Sciences High School Summer Programs
org: University of Pennsylvania, Penn LPS High School Programs
what_you_do: Summer Academies (2 or 3 weeks, non-credit, residential), Pre-College (residential or online, for credit) and Online Seminars on topics like biomedical research, economics, forensic science and neuroscience.
pay_detail: 2026 tuition: 2-week Academy $6,700; 3-week Academy $10,050; Pre-College Residential $15,192 to $23,604; Pre-College Online $8,692 or $14,300; Online Seminars $2,950. $1,500 deposit and $100 application fee (waived for School District of Philadelphia applicants).
duration: 2 to 6 weeks depending on program (2026 Academies: July 11 to August 1)
deadline_text: 2026: May 1 for Academies and Pre-College Residential/Online Session I; June 1 for Online Seminars and Pre-College Online Session II. Rolling admissions. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Online application from the student: essays (400 words each), transcript, recommendations. For the scholarship, say you attend a School District of Philadelphia school and fill in the scholarship section.
notes: There are no scholarships for the Pre-College programs. Contact hsprogs@sas.upenn.edu or 215-746-2309.
